arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Consecration's{/c} size is increased by {c_number}[(SF_9 / SF_10 - 1) * 100 |%|]{/c}

While inside {c_important}Consecration{/c}, you and your allies deal {c_number}[{SF_23} * 100|%x|]{/c} additional damage and consume {c_number}[{SF_24} * 100|%x|]{/c} less resource.
{c_important}Consecration{/c} Immobilizes enemies and can be cast anywhere.

{c_important}Consecration{/c} lasts {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds, increasing its damage and Healing by {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%|]{/c} each second.

{c_important}Consecration{/c} detonates when it expires, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_BURST}{/c} damage to all enemies and Healing you and your allies for {c_number}[{SF_25} * 100|%|]{/c} of their Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_25})]){/c}.
{c_important}Consecration's{/c} initial Cast {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[SF_30*100|1%|]{/c} of Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} per enemy hit.
{c_important}Consecration{/c} increases Primary Resource Generation for you and your allies by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|+%|]{/c}.
